Implemented [Dashboard.tsx](/workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx) using the existing `Promise.all` pattern to fetch all three APIs concurrently.

- Displays analytics, notifications, and settings in labeled sections.
- Resolves API URLs for server-side fetching.
- Shows an error message if fetching or JSON parsing fails.

Added [tests](/workspace/app/Dashboard.test.tsx) covering concurrency, rendering, and failures. All four tests, TypeScript checks, and the production build pass.

Responses use formatted JSON because no response schemas are defined. The API routes themselves are not present in this repository.

Responses use formatted JSON because no response schemas are defined. The API routes themselves are not present in this repository.
